outcome: Age of onset of atopic dermatitis
cohort: 1,399,406 children born in Sweden between January 2006 and December 2018
finding: Children born by caesarean section or instrumental vaginal delivery were at higher risk of early childhood atopic dermatitis, particularly in the first year of life.
mod_finding: Both emergency and elective caesarean sections were associated with an increased risk of atopic dermatitis compared to uncomplicated vaginal delivery.
